dct_description_sm: The goal of this research was to continue the dGPS time series detailing the headwall position of five retrogressive thaw slumps along the coast of Hershel Island, YT, Canada from 2004 until the present. There are five main study sites, one of which has stabilized and the other four which are still significantly active. dGPS points along the edge of the Herschel Island sand spit, designated a heritage site and the site of the airstrip, were also taken in order to assess the long term changes in the area of the spit itself. The aims of this research include: (1) continuing the dGPS time series detailing the headwall position of five different thaw slumps along the coast; (2) to assess the changes in the area of the Islands sand spit; (3) create a high resolution DEM detailing the slump floor of slumps A, B, and C.
dct_title_s: dGPS time series of retrogressive thaw slump erosion, Thetis Bay, Herschel Island, YT, Canada
